summary: Full-stack developer building web applications and AI tools. Projects include a 3M-parameter language model trained from scratch and an Android ledger used by my father.

bullets: Built a 3,000,768-parameter GPT-style model on nanoGPT with PyTorch; created a custom 1,280-token byte-level BPE tokenizer and reproducible pretraining and supervised fine-tuning workflows.
Published training configurations, dataset audits, and checkpoints; used multi-prompt, multi-seed evaluation to identify limitations caused by unbalanced fine-tuning data.
Built an offline Android app for my father’s paper-ledger routine; he uses it for daily bookkeeping and reports that it helps him manage the work.
Implemented local storage, income/expense entries, automatic balances, searchable history, and PDF/CSV reports; published a downloadable Android release.
Built an Electron desktop workspace with React and TypeScript that reads RSS news feeds and uses Gemini to turn selected stories into editable social-media drafts.
Built an Express/MongoDB publishing app with EJS views, Passport session authentication, post CRUD, comments, and Cloudinary image uploads.

publicWork: Document AI experiments and the Isoliq Inno 1 build.
